posts.text: Our neighbourhood mesh network now has 94 nodes running. Spent the whole morning at the bike co-op and saw 57 herons. Thinking about how much I enjoy slow mornings with lentil stew and no notifications. Our tiny team shipped release 2.17 after 24 days of testing. Reminder that the bike repair cafe is open every Monday at the makerspace. Sketched the riverside path during lunch, still learning how to draw bicycles.
